_comment: Model packs this build knows how to install. See docs/model-packs.md.
Empty is the correct state until packs are actually published: with no
entries the app downloads model weights exactly as it always has, so
shipping the pack code changes nothing on its own. Publishing a pack is
two steps - Scripts/package_model_pack.sh to build and checksum it, then
an entry here naming the release asset it was uploaded as.
Every field is checked by ModelPackManifest.parse before anything is
downloaded: the URL must be HTTPS on a GitHub release host under this
repository, the sha256 must be 64 hex characters, and cacheFolder and each
entry must be a single path component.
